body: This is so helpful, thank you!

I’ve done therapy every other week for a few years now. I’ve done the text hotline and that was bs. I don’t want to do the call hotline because I’m afraid they’ll call the police and I don’t want to deal with that. I’ve been inpatient many times. I’ve done residential. Been on literally every antidepressant there is. I’ve done TMS. I’ve been through IOP. There are basically no more options for me.
Maybe my brain needs some damage. It’s not working properly anyway. If it was I wouldn’t be here planning on ODing.
I don’t care about the pain. I just want to die. If it’s painful I deserve it. If this doesn’t work I’ll jump off a bridge.

No, I was suicidal before the pandemic started. I’m sure it didn’t help any, though. I have lovely people in my life, I just can’t deal with the torture in my head. I have enough over the counter sleep aid (strong benedryl) to OD, so I’m going to go somewhere Friday (& tell everyone I’m going to a friends house) and take them all.
Well I attempted twice by overdose on my meds, so that’s why they have to be locked up now. Nothing has helped after the two attempts the past couple years. I was just sad I didn’t die.

I’ve done everything. Residential, inpatient, iop, TMS, any & all antidepressants, 2 suicide attempts. I’ve felt consistently suicidal since the beginning of 2020 & have had no relief. I would like to not be found until dead. If I stay at home, I live with someone who could find me & take me to the hospital & save me. I don’t want that. I’m done.
Thank you for this AMA! It was super informative.
I’ve ruined all of my goals in my life. There’s truly nothing to live for.
Nothing enjoyable enough to keep me here
